parsed.scene_description: A modern, brightly lit interior space with large windows allowing natural light. People sit at tables, some working on laptops. A prominent red curved wall dominates the right side. Bookshelves spiral upward in the background. The floor is polished and reflective.

objects.label: large windows
objects.observation: Tall, rectangular glass panes span the left wall, letting in bright daylight. They frame outdoor greenery. Vertical metal frames divide them. Light glare obscures details outside.

objects.label: red curved wall
objects.observation: A smooth, glossy red surface curves from the foreground to midground on the right. It partially blocks the view of the background. Its edge is sharp against the ceiling and floor.

objects.label: people sitting
objects.observation: Several individuals are seated at round tables near the windows. One person wears dark clothing and sits facing away. Another person is partially visible behind them. They appear engaged with devices or conversation.

objects.label: round tables
objects.observation: Circular tables with metallic legs are placed throughout the room. Some have chairs around them. One table has a laptop on it. Their surfaces reflect the ambient light.

objects.label: spiral bookshelf
objects.observation: A tall, cylindrical bookshelf with multiple shelves spirals upward in the background. Books are arranged on its tiers. It is positioned behind the seated people and next to a purple-lit section.

objects.label: ceiling structure
objects.observation: The ceiling features exposed beams and recessed lighting fixtures. A decorative, wavy metal element hangs from it above the windows. The ceiling slopes downward toward the center of the room.
